title: Public statement step, reset, and finalize lifecycle

scope.rationale: These public VDBE lifecycle functions form one dependency-closed unit around execution, automatic restart, prior-result publication, and final ownership release.
excluded_responsibilities: Full schema bytecode recompilation beyond the bounded native prepared-program owner
Independent pinned-C trace and assurance review

external_source_responsibilities: Connection statement linkage and deferred zombie close
dependencies.caller_closure: All public callers route directly through the mapped statement exports; the native VM and connection finalizer own their lower-level state transitions.

inputs: Nullable or live native prepared-statement handle
outputs: Masked step result, prior reset result, or final execution result
contracts.ownership: Step and reset borrow the statement. Finalize releases VM, bindings, SQL, owned compile context, and connection linkage exactly once.
contracts.state_and_results: Step auto-resets halted statements, consumes bounded variable-sensitive reprepare state, and preserves the live result-code mask. Reset rewinds without clearing counters. NULL reset/finalize are successful no-ops.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Connection event/profile/finalize callbacks remain delegated to the existing native statement and connection owners; no direct I/O is introduced.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Interrupt, OOM, and execution errors remain resettable or finalizable; finalize publishes the retained prior result while completing deferred close.

representation_differences: Typed Zig statement and VM owners replace raw Vdbe casts; bounded native reprepare keeps the compiled program while consuming the expiration marker and counting the event.

oracle.protocol: Prepare, bind, step through ROW and DONE, repeat step for automatic reset, reset after success/error, finalize live and NULL handles, and exercise deferred connection close.
internal_observations: statement state, prior result, counters, result mask, and connection linkage
oracle.normalization: Compare primary/extended result codes, row values, run/reprepare counts, and post-finalize connection continuation.

assurance.oom: Existing VM and owner cleanup releases every allocation on execution or finalization failure.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No new persistent mutation; statement execution delegates transactions and I/O to native owners.
assurance.malformed_input: NULL handles preserve source reset/finalize no-op and step misuse behavior.
assurance.continuation: Halted and failed statements can auto-reset or explicitly reset; finalization remains valid after all result paths.
assurance.performance: Constant lifecycle overhead around native VM execution.

integration.native_call_path: Public C API callers invoke the mapped exports, which execute and release the production native VM and connection-owned statement chain.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Prior wrappers that returned MISUSE for NULL reset and rejected repeated step after halt are replaced.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C trace, full schema recompile closure, and independent review remain open.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C internal trace for complete schema reprepare loops.
Complete assurance and independent fidelity review.

implementation_spans: Complete pinned sqlite3_finalize(), sqlite3_reset(), and sqlite3_step() bodies
Native statement execution, reset, destruction, result-mask, event, and connection-finalization owners
callers: Public C statement API, sqlite3_exec(), prepared SQL tests, and deferred connection close
callees: Statement.step/reset/destroy, Vm.step/reset/deinit, and connection finalize callback
assertions_branches_cleanup: NULL handling, halted auto-reset, expiration consumption, prior-result publication, ownership release, and result masking reviewed
upstream_tests: Native statement and public frontend lifecycle tests
